name: invoicego
description: InvoiceGO — FBR Digital Invoicing web application for Pakistani businesses

scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix server && npm ci --prefix web
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix web && rm -rf server/public && cp -r web/dist server/public && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix web
